name: devbook-skills
description: Reusable guidance any plugin can name and none has to depend on. Ships show-me: put a picture before the prose whenever the content has a shape — a Mermaid sequence, state, or flow diagram, a file tree labelled with what each entry is for, a type signature, a diff, a call stack, pseudocode, or a table — and keep the prose after it to the reasons, the exceptions, and the limits. Ships research-brief: answer one question about something outside the repository from primary sources only, every claim cited with a confidence, and say what the sources leave open; it returns the brief and writes nothing, so the caller decides where it lands. Ships pr-body: write a pull request description as Summary, Evidence, and Merge Danger — one picture of the change, a tiered before and after, and a one-way or two-way door with its blast radius, a one-way door linking its decision record — inside the repository's own template. Ships retro: run a retrospective over one session or one delivery run with the person present, through lenses from navigation and automated checks to unused context, tool economy, and model and effort, ranking what would make the next run get further — a mechanical violation gets a check, never a written rule — and presents the candidates without writing anything. Ships wayfinder, invoked by the person alone: plan an effort too big for one session as a wayfinder:map issue on the repository's own tracker — destination, notes, decisions so far, fog, and what is out of scope — with research, prototype, grilling, and task tickets as child issues linked by native blocking, and resolve one frontier ticket per session until nothing is left to decide; it writes issues and nothing in the repository. Named by skill, never declared: devbook's devbook-writing rule names show-me for every chapter but domain.md, the delivery engine names it for pull request descriptions and its report back to the person, the engine's scope and arc42 and tech drafting name research-brief, the engine's pull request phase and the schedule sweeps' draft pull requests name pr-body, and the engine's Summary and the weekly retro schedule name retro, each keeping its own rule when the skill is absent. Materializes nothing into a repository and stamps nothing.
